  • 英語名: Relaxation Yuubi Anata Dake no Himitsu no Iyashi

あらすじ

One day, the protagonist is ordered by his company to go on a two-month business trip. Having often gone to massage parlors in his hometown, he ends up looking for a massage parlor on the business trip. The massage parlor he finds is “Relaxation Yuubi”. It has a calm atmosphere and reliable treatments by the owner and therapist, Miho. There are no sexual services, but the comfort and pleasure of the massages lead the protagonist to return again and again.

There, Taketo catches the attention of three female guards feared by all inmates.

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Herencia
  • 発売日: 2014-09-26
  • スコア: 6.63/10 (49 人評価)
  • 日本語名: セーラーエレメント
  • 英語名: Sailor Element

あらすじ

A world made of human hope, Initium, and a world made of human despair, Finis.

The two worlds existed in different dimension than the human world, and never interacted with each other.

However, one day, the King of Finis, Malm, decided to rule over all worlds.

He hijacked Initium, and finally began to advance into the human world.
